subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Proclaim
solution:
The correct answer is 'Conceal'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Proclaim is a verb that means to announce officially or publicly.
 
• The meaning of the given options is as follows - 
 
 
• Announce - make a formal public statement about a fact, occurrence, or intention.
 
• Conceal - prevent (something) from being known; keep secret.
 
• Exhibit - publicly display (a work of art or item of interest) in an art gallery or museum or at a trade fair.
 
• Evince - reveal the presence of (a quality or feeling); indicate.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings, it is evident that conceal is the correct antonym for the word proclaim.
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.
